about.title: Built for hard rock mining
about.body: With 24 years of experience in the used mining and construction equipment industry, Trayde Plant & Equipment has built a reputation for supplying good quality used and unused underground mining equipment. We specialise in sourcing, refurbishing and rebuilding machines to get them working on your operation – fast.

inv.subCat: Eight specialised lines – every unit walk-around inspected before it lands on our floor.
inv.title: On the floor this week
inv.sub: Used, rebuilt and unused machines – priced in Rand, inspected on site. Call for a full walk-around report on any unit.

categories.name: FLAMEPROOF
categories.desc: Certified units for gassy working places
categories.detail:
Flameproof equipment is essential wherever methane or other flammable gases may be present underground.

We stock and source flameproof shuttle cars, feeder breakers, LHDs and support equipment.

If you need a specific flameproof machine, get in touch.

categories.name: LHD'S
categories.detail:
LHD loaders are the workhorses of underground mining.

We carry a wide range from 3-tonne compact units up to 17-tonne production loaders.

Every LHD is walk-around inspected and load-tested before it leaves our yard.

categories.name: DUMP TRUCKS
categories.detail:
Underground articulated dump trucks move ore and waste from the loading point to the surface.

We supply CAT AD-series and Sandvik TH-series trucks.

Need a matched fleet? Get in touch.

categories.name: GRADERS
categories.detail:
Underground graders maintain the floor and profile of declines, drifts and intersections.

We supply low-profile underground graders including CAT 120H underground-spec machines.

Tell us your tunnel dimensions and we'll match the right grader.

categories.name: DRILLS & BOLTERS
categories.desc: Face drills, long-hole rigs & roof bolters
categories.detail:
Development and production drilling plus ground support are at the heart of every underground operation.

We supply face drills, long-hole production rigs, and roof bolters from Sandvik, Atlas Copco / Epiroc.

Whether you need a single drill or a fleet, get in touch.

categories.name: UTILITY VEHICLES
categories.detail:
Utility vehicles keep an underground mine running.

We stock scissor lifts, scalers, shotcreters, agicars from Aard, MacLean, Jacon, Sandvik.

From a single scissor lift to a full utility fleet, tell us what you need.

categories.name: OTHER
categories.desc: Anything else we can source for you
categories.detail:
Can't find what you need? We source conveyors, pumps, ventilation, locomotives, winches and more.

With 24 years in the industry, if a machine exists we can usually find it.

Nothing is too obscure — get in touch.

categories.name: COMPONENTS
categories.detail:
Keep your fleet turning with parts held ex stock in Gauteng.

Hydraulic cylinders, gear assemblies, drill rods, conveyor rollers, torque converters, axles, buckets, tyres and wear parts.

For regular consumers we can set up standing supply arrangements.

needed.title: We're always buying good used & unused underground mining equipment
needed.body: We are constantly looking for good used or unused underground mining equipment — LHDs, dump trucks, drills, bolters, graders, flameproof units and more. If you have equipment to sell and need assistance finding the right buyer, get in touch.

items.q: Do you buy used underground mining equipment?
items.a: Yes. We are constant buyers of good used and unused underground mining equipment. Get in touch for a free, confidential valuation.

items.q: Do you sell used and unused underground mining equipment?
items.a: Yes. We supply good quality used and unused underground mining equipment across South Africa, fully inspected and ready for delivery.

items.q: What condition is the equipment in?
items.a: Equipment is sold as-is, rebuilt, or fully refurbished to OEM specification. Every unit is walk-around inspected and load-tested.

items.q: Can I inspect equipment before buying?
items.a: Absolutely. Site visits are welcome by appointment at our Gauteng yard.
Pricing reflects machine condition, hours, OEM specification and current market demand. Contact us for a tailored quote.

items.q: Do you offer rebuilds before purchase?
items.a: Yes. Many units can be purchased as-is or fully rebuilt to your specification.
Yes. We organise transport and deliver equipment across South Africa.

items.q: How do I sell my equipment to you?
items.a: Send us the make, model, year, hours, condition and photos via the contact form or email.
Yes. All valuations and transactions are handled in strict confidence.

items.q: What payment terms do you offer?
items.a: Payment terms are agreed per transaction — typically EFT on collection or delivery.

ct.sub: Tell us what you're mining and what you need hauled – we'll match the iron.
